window_base_paint_evidence.order_implication: A visible normal window first passes the common background/base paint gate; derived window paint and child controls are separate subsequent call paths. This proves a base-before-child constraint, but not overlap order between two movable windows.

cross_window_order_rule.paint_dispatch: 0x004280F0–0x00428357 consumes main+0xD28 linked-list order; each node ID is dispatched to one specialized paint VA before node+0x04 is read.
cross_window_order_rule.consequence: The final overlapping-window order is runtime list order, not a universal hard-coded category order. A later node paints over an earlier node when their rectangles overlap.
cross_window_order_rule.implementation_note: The restoration preview should expose list order as a debug layer and keep explicit z-order data separate from each window's local paint order.
